development_screen: Verified primary full-coverage Jan-Apr ledger: all months nonnegative, arithmetic mean at least10%, at least10completed actual trades. Diagnostic routes cannot rescue a failed primary. This screen does not replace original case acceptance.
acceptance: May/July/September full net capital month arithmetic mean at least10%; all May-September months nonnegative and full coverage. No month-specific fitting or extra future observation period gate. Exposed historical data remain development regression.
capital: Original settled-cash rule, allocation0/1 only; at most one ETF, no leverage, same-day reentry forbidden, T+1 and available dividend cash handled normally. V25 full-cash/dividend wait rule is not applied. All fees/slippage, dividends/splits, cross-month MTM and unknown-held occupation retained. Cash0 does not meet growth objective.
contract: Four sequential clocks09:25:30/10:05:30/10:35:30/13:05:30ET, same completeddata and30sextra delay to nextregular5mOpen, within6minutes. Attached centrounded+5%TP,fixed6%stop,stopfirstsamebar,actualadversegapfill. Max14inclusivecalendar days,lastofficialclose on/before entry+13. No v30preclose exits. Halfday clocks>=close absent. V4 arbitrarytime interface retained/unqualified.
source: Reuse immutable independently verified v35 raw and as-issued calibrated forecasts, input/financial panels and fixed trade labels. Check all top-level, daily and training SHAs against committed v35 delivery manifest. Underlying base models remain daily-retrained on data available before that day; using cached issued forecasts does not freeze the economic model to one old month. No raw source downloads or uploads.
case_workflow: A failed independently verified primary blocks beforecreating any caseoutput. If primary passes, extend v35 raw/as-issued forecasts using the unchanged v35 daily financial/price recipe throughSeptember, preserve all preMay records, then apply the frozen v38 meta rules to continuousMaySeptember. Source extension engineering is not implemented by the development runner; it must be completed and verified if authorized. No case fitting or primaryswitch.

features.top_lower: source calibrated top score minus original common risk radius
features.raw_direction_agreement: sign*(original raw L-original raw S), sign +1 for L and -1 for S
features.aligned_relative5: sign*existing relative_5, volatility-normalized SOXX-vs-QQQ 5-day relative return
features.aligned_breadth5: sign*existing breadth_5, already 2*8-issuer positive fraction-1; not centered twice
features.aligned_volume_diffusion: sign*existing volume_direction_diffusion at current completed clock

fit: Weighted standardization uses original date-split weights. y=1(selected net log return>0), magnitude weights=w*abs(return), normalized to N dates. Objective sum(m*(logaddexp(0,eta)-y*eta))+5||beta||^2, free intercept, equivalent L2 LogisticRegression C=.1. Damped Newton,100 iterations, max gradient<1e-8, Armijo backtrack1e-4 with additive1e-13 arithmetic tolerance; failures raise. Single class or zero magnitude uses constant gain share (all zero=>.5), not certainty. Uniform return scaling does not change normalized fitting weights.
meaning: Not win probability: ideal q(x)=E[positivepart(net log return)|x]/E[abs(net log return)|x]. q>.5 iff expected net log return positive at an unrestricted population optimum. A regularized finite-history estimate is not a guarantee. 60% wins at+.04 and40% losses at-.08 gives gain share .24/.56<.5. Threshold .5 follows zero expected log return, not month-return tuning. This alone does not optimize turnover or a monthly floor.
hypothesis: V37 mixed all as-issued top choices but applied its risk gate to source-qualified candidates. Its available qualified history had positive mean while all-top history turned negative; three of seven removed actual trades also exceeded historical input ranges. Test qualification-conditioned learning and marginal support checks as separate factors. These exposed diagnostics motivate this development experiment, not independent evidence or date-specific exceptions.
eligibility: Use immutable v35 full_band action in SOXL/SOXS as historically determined proposal eligibility. This is before account occupancy, not actual fills or future wins. Select only that as-issued calibrated top ETF label. No second-place replacement. All-candidate comparison includes every ready as-issued top choice, even source-rejected. Feature and outcome definitions exactly v37.
history: Daily00ET, same complete whole-date paired-terminal chronological prefix, stop at first unknown/notyetmatured date. Retain latest120 dates with all source fullcalibrated scores ready. Project qualified clock rows inside this common history; dates without eligible rows contribute none to conditional fit. Qualification never bypasses unresolved prefix. Current/future records cannot enter.
warmup: Every newly fitted comparison starts only when common pool has>=60 dates AND qualified subset has>=30 distinct dates.30 is a fixed small-sample floor above twice the13 predictors plus intercept; no search over floors. Earlier source model is preserved exactly. Shared warmup prevents attributing warmup changes to qualification. Original v37 also retained as separate exact control with original60-date-only warmup.
weights: For each retained subset, date age uses original common-pool position j, weight2^((j-Ncommon+1)/63), not compressed eligible-event count. Normalize selected date weights to Nsubset distinct dates; distribute each date equally among retained clock rows (qualified only for eligible fit). Each head normalizes loss-magnitude weights to its own Nsubset, keeping C=.1 penalty in date units. All-top fit uses original date-split weights. Small conditional subset consequently has stronger regularization relative to data than all-top model.

models.eligible_context: PRIMARY eligible rows, same13 v37 features

support: Using original point-fit members, store marginal min/max for every input column, including constant/binary/clock fields. Query is supported only if all finite columns fall inside inclusive range with1e-12 arithmetic tolerance. Any outside column prevents supported risk model from overriding source; preserve source proposal and record column names. This is a marginal bounding box, not proof of joint density or predictive validity. Rejected source proposals stay cash; support fallback cannot create new source-ineligible buys.
decision: PRIMARY retains source-qualified top only when supported conditional quality>.5+1e-12. No source proposal=>cash. Warmup or outside support=>original source proposal. Missing source/features or expired unresolved prefix=>cash. Unrestricted conditional comparison applies same q gate even outside support. All-top supported/unrestricted comparisons use same common warmup. Conditional scores comparison checks its7-input support. Conditional band diagnostic checks13-input support then uses lowerquality. No diagnostic can rescue failed primary.
bootstrap: 199 circular10-date draws on COMMON parent-date sequence, seed826+ETdateordinal. Same multiplicity perturbs conditional and all-top fits. Refit standardization and loss-magnitude normalization per model using original subset date-count normalization. A draw with zero eligible rows remains None, never fabricated or silently resampled. If any replicate unknown, band quality unknown and band route rejects within support; primary point route remains usable. Bootstrap only new risk models, source forecasts fixed as-issued.

routes.eligible_supported: PRIMARY eligible context with marginal-support fallback
routes.eligible_gate: same conditional model without support check

routes.double_cost: primary frozen proposals, double-cost own labels
